goal: Replace Apptio TBM Studio with an in-house pipeline that charges back 100% of cloud cost to portfolios and business units via a pipeline from Cloudability -> Lambda -> S3 -> Databricks Medallion (PySpark) -> FOCUS v1.4 -> REST API & Power BI.

tickets.title: Define cost group hierarchy and allocation rules
tickets.description: Document the cost groups (Vendor Consumption Costs, Shared Costs, Platform, Portfolio, Application) and the allocation order (CSP -> Shared -> Platform -> Portfolio -> Business Unit). Include rules for 'cost follows cost' for shared costs and definitions for consumption types (direct, shared, prop*). Produce a concise reference that the allocation engine can use.
acceptance: Cost groups and allocation order are documented in a single authoritative file in docs/
Shared cost calculation method is specified with formula and an example that reconciles to totals
Consumption types list matches the Lambda and Databricks implementation plan

tickets.title: Evaluate Databricks vs Snowflake as the analysis platform
tickets.description: Compare Databricks and Snowflake for running the Medallion PySpark pipeline, including network egress requirements, support for Delta, cost of compute, and operational fit with Databricks workspace finops-rnd-prod. Provide recommendation to justify the chosen platform.
acceptance: Comparison matrix with performance, cost, and operational criteria published
Network egress firewall implications for Databricks are assessed and documented
Recommendation decision recorded with estimated cost delta

tickets.title: Write enterprise architecture blueprint
tickets.description: Produce an architecture blueprint showing Cloudability v3 API -> Lambda -> S3 -> Databricks Bronze/Silver/Gold -> FOCUS v1.4 -> REST API -> Power BI. Specify secrets handling, env vars (OUTPUT_BUCKET, CLOUDABILITY_SECRET_NAME, CLOUDABILITY_API_BASE), and deployment boundaries.
acceptance: Architecture diagram in docs/ that matches the pipeline flow
Secrets handling strategy documented and reviewed
Blueprint lists required env vars and deployable components

tickets.title: Map Cloudability fields to FOCUS v1.4
tickets.description: Create a field-level mapping from Cloudability v3 fields to the FOCUS v1.4 schema, noting missing ResourceId/SKU details and how x_ and Allocated* fields will be populated later. Include tag/categor y sources for business unit fields.
acceptance: Mapping table covering all FOCUS v1.4 columns and Cloudability source fields
Missing field gaps are enumerated and mitigation notes provided
Mapping file validated by loading a sample Cloudability CSV and confirming column presence

tickets.title: Specify custom x_ columns (data dictionary)
tickets.description: Define the x_ columns (x_ConsumptionType, x_SharedCost_*, x_PlatformId/x_PlatformName, x_PortfolioId/x_PortfolioName, x_ExchangeRate, x_BusinessUnit_*) and the semantics for fallbacks (x_VP from tag5->category17). Provide field types and validation rules.
acceptance: Data dictionary file docs/ specifying types and fallbacks for each x_ column
Validation rules list for each x_ column with example values
Dictionary reconciles to FOCUS v1.4 schema and mapping (FIN-4)

tickets.title: Derive business unit hierarchy from Cloudability tags
tickets.description: Define the algorithm to extract BusinessUnit_* fields from Cloudability tags (tag2, tag5, tag8, tag12, tag14, tag15, tag17, tag22, tag23, tag35, category17-19, category22) and how to validate against the master department file. Specify fallback rules and tagging precedence.
acceptance: Extraction algorithm documented with tag precedence and fallbacks
Unit tests or sample transformations for 10 representative Cloudability rows
Validation step that flags unknown departments against department_lookup.csv

tickets.title: Lambda: extract Cloudability v3 cost data to S3 as FOCUS CSV
tickets.description: Implement an AWS Lambda that calls the Cloudability v3 API, paginates, handles rate limits and retries, and writes FOCUS v1.4-compatible CSV to S3. The Lambda reads the API key from Secrets Manager and uses OUTPUT_BUCKET, CLOUDABILITY_SECRET_NAME, CLOUDABILITY_API_BASE env vars. Return HTTP 200/207/500 as specified.
acceptance: Lambda returns HTTP 200 for full success, 207 for partial success, 500 when no rows processed
Produced CSV files in S3 validate against the FOCUS v1.4 schema validator
Secret is read from AWS Secrets Manager and env vars are required and validated

tickets.title: Secrets Manager integration and environment configuration
tickets.description: Configure AWS Secrets Manager usage for the Lambda and document required environment variables OUTPUT_BUCKET, CLOUDABILITY_SECRET_NAME, CLOUDABILITY_API_BASE. Include IAM role permissions needed for SecretsManager and S3 writes.
acceptance: IAM policy document shows least-privilege for SecretsManager and S3 writes
Deployable Lambda config template includes required env vars
Integration tested: Lambda reads secret and writes a small test CSV to the OUTPUT_BUCKET

tickets.title: Confirm Cloudability report configuration
tickets.description: Confirm the Cloudability report endpoint and query parameters that provide the SKU, tag and category detail required for FOCUS v1.4; record the exact API path and sample response for production use.
acceptance: Exact Cloudability v3 endpoint and query parameters recorded in docs/
Sample API response saved showing required tag/category fields
Confirmation that the report includes SKU or mitigation documented

tickets.title: Pagination, rate limiting and retry handling for the Cloudability API
tickets.description: Design and implement pagination and exponential backoff retries for Cloudability API calls in the Lambda, including handling of 429/5xx responses and partial-row errors per platform, returning 207 when appropriate.
acceptance: Lambda includes pagination loop and exponential backoff retry logic
Retries and throttling behavior tested with simulated 429/5xx responses
Partial-row errors are isolated and result in HTTP 207 with an error summary

tickets.title: GCP cost ingestion and FOCUS output via PySpark Medallion
tickets.description: Implement PySpark jobs that parse GCP billing data into FOCUS v1.4 CSV, handling GCP-specific consumption types and tagging, and write to the Databricks Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion layers.
acceptance: PySpark job produces FOCUS v1.4 CSVs for GCP sample billing files
Bronze->Silver transformation conforms to data dictionary and schema validator
End-to-end test demonstrates GCP sample file reaching Gold with expected columns

tickets.title: AWS cost conversion to FOCUS v1.4
tickets.description: Create the AWS-specific ingestion and PySpark transformation to produce FOCUS v1.4 CSVs from AWS billing exports, mapping AWS cost and tag fields into x_ and BusinessUnit_* columns.
acceptance: AWS job converts sample billing export into FOCUS v1.4 CSV
BusinessUnit_* fields populated from expected AWS tags for sample data
Conversion unit test that asserts column presence and types

tickets.title: Azure cost conversion to FOCUS v1.4
tickets.description: Plan and implement Azure billing ingestion and PySpark mapping to FOCUS v1.4, reusing common normalization logic and handling Azure-specific SKU/tag conventions.
acceptance: Azure mapping design document saved in docs/
Sample Azure billing file transforms to FOCUS v1.4 CSV in a test run
Edge cases for missing tags enumerated and fallback behaviour defined

tickets.title: OCI cost conversion to FOCUS v1.4
tickets.description: Plan OCI billing ingestion and mapping to FOCUS v1.4 for OCI accounts, documenting any differences in tag semantics and available SKUs.
acceptance: OCI mapping plan recorded in docs/
Sample OCI billing data mapped to FOCUS v1.4 in a smoke test
Known gaps for OCI documented with mitigation steps

tickets.title: FOCUS v1.4 schema validator
tickets.description: Provide a validator that checks CSV files against FOCUS v1.4 column presence, types and the x_ column rules, returning pass/fail and a list of failing rows for use in CI and the Lambda end-to-end verification.
acceptance: Validator script returns non-zero exit on schema violations
Validator produces an errors CSV with failing row numbers and reasons
Validator is used to assert Lambda output and Databricks Gold outputs

tickets.title: Unblock Databricks network egress (firewall whitelist)
tickets.blocked: waiting on firewall and networking meeting
tickets.description: Work with networking to whitelist outbound HTTPS from the databricks workspace finops-rnd-prod to GCP APIs, Cloudability and GitHub so the Medallion and API tests can run. Record approved IP ranges or DNS egress rules.
acceptance: Firewall rules allow finops-rnd-prod outbound HTTPS to required hosts
Approved egress list committed to docs/ with dates and approver
Connectivity smoke test from Databricks to each external API succeeds

tickets.title: S3 landing zone layout, encryption and lifecycle
tickets.description: Define the S3 landing zone layout for raw Cloudability CSVs, encryption settings, bucket policies and lifecycle rules for Bronze/Silver/Gold retention. Ensure OUTPUT_BUCKET usage aligns with lifecycle.
acceptance: S3 bucket policy and encryption settings are documented
Lifecycle rules for raw/bronze/silver/gold are specified with retention periods
Landing zone layout diagram and bucket naming conventions provided

tickets.title: Bronze layer: raw ingestion into Delta
tickets.description: Implement Databricks jobs to ingest raw FOCUS CSVs from S3 into a Delta bronze layer, capturing source metadata and partitioning by billing period, with idempotent writes.
acceptance: Bronze job ingests sample CSVs into Delta with partitioned layout
Source metadata (source file, ingestion timestamp) is recorded per row
Idempotency test: re-running ingestion does not duplicate rows

tickets.title: Silver layer: cleanse and conform to FOCUS
tickets.description: Implement Silver transformations that cleanse and conform Bronze data to the FOCUS v1.4 data dictionary, applying type casts and basic validation checks.
acceptance: Silver transformations pass the FOCUS validator for provided sample datasets
Null and type edge cases are handled and documented
Automated test asserts Silver row counts before/after cleanse

tickets.title: Gold layer: allocation-ready cost facts
tickets.description: Produce the Gold layer that contains allocation-ready cost facts with x_ columns and business unit fields populated, ready for the allocation engine to consume.
acceptance: Gold dataset includes all FOCUS v1.4 columns and populated x_ fields
Sample reconciliation shows totals preserved from Bronze to Gold
Gold table schema documented and available to the allocation engine

tickets.title: Master data: department lookup and cost center master file
tickets.description: Create a master department_lookup.csv and cost center master file used to validate and map untagged Cloudability rows and to supply chargeback cost centers for AllocatedTags. Define process for manual additions.
acceptance: department_lookup.csv contains mappings for the top 200 cost center tags or an agreed subset
Validation step flags unknown tags and creates a reviewable exceptions CSV
Procedure for manual entries documented and tested with sample unknown rows

tickets.title: Direct cost allocation
tickets.description: Implement allocation rules to assign direct consumption costs to the owning portfolio or business unit, populating Allocated* columns and AllocatedMethodId according to mapping rules (Cloudability tag33).
acceptance: Direct allocation runs produce AllocatedResourceId/Name for sample dataset
AllocatedMethodId is populated and maps to tag33 values for test cases
End-to-end run reconciles total input cost to allocated outputs

tickets.title: Shared cost allocation (cost follows cost)
tickets.description: Implement account-level shared cost allocation where each account's share equals its percentage of total measured usage for the billing period. Produce shared-cost records consumable by downstream APIs.
acceptance: Shared allocation algorithm documented with formula and example
Shared-cost output records sum to the shared cost total within 0.01 tolerance
Allocation job includes unit tests verifying percent-based splits

tickets.title: Proportional consumption types (propaws, propres, propgcp, propedp, propazure)
tickets.description: Support proportional consumption allocation types for each cloud (propaws, propres, propgcp, propedp, propazure) so that platform-level shared costs can be distributed based on measured proportional consumption.
acceptance: Proportional allocation modes implemented and selectable per cloud
Unit tests show proportional splits for synthetic platform usage
Documentation includes how proportional types map to consumption_type values

tickets.title: Platform and portfolio allocation
tickets.description: Allocate platform-level and portfolio-level costs after CSP and shared allocations, populating Allocated* columns and AllocatedTags for reporting and rollup to business units.
acceptance: Platform and portfolio allocations appear in output with AllocatedTags populated
Allocations reconcile to post-shared totals
API-ready records contain platformId and portfolioId fields

tickets.title: Business unit chargeback rollup
tickets.description: Roll up allocated costs to business unit levels (Department, SVP, VP, DP, Director, Team, Owner) and ensure chargeback cost centers are selected for billing exports.
acceptance: Rollups produce aggregated totals per business unit that sum to allocated inputs
Chargeback cost center fields are present for export
Rollup queries perform within expected time bounds for sample month

tickets.title: Allocation lineage: method id and Cloudability tag33 mapping
tickets.description: Track allocation lineage by populating AllocatedMethodId and AllocatedMethodDetails and map the method id to Cloudability tag33 where applicable, for auditability of allocation decisions.
acceptance: AllocatedMethodId is populated for allocated rows in sample runs
Mapping of method ids to tag33 values is documented
Allocation lineage allows tracing an output row back to input rows in Gold

tickets.title: Cost neutrality reconciliation
tickets.description: Create automated reconciliation that asserts total input cost equals total allocated output cost after all allocation steps, with a tolerance and detailed diff report for investigation.
acceptance: Reconciliation script runs nightly and exits non-zero on mismatch beyond tolerance
Reconciliation report highlights rows contributing to mismatches
Reconciliation is covered by a CI test with a synthetic dataset

tickets.title: Unallocated and untagged cost exception report
tickets.description: Produce an exceptions report listing unallocated and untagged costs, with sample context and suggested department_lookup.csv entries for manual remediation.
acceptance: Exceptions report shows untagged rows with source file and line identifiers
Top untagged reasons are summarized and documented
A CSV of suggested department_lookup entries is produced for manual review

tickets.title: REST API: raw and shared cost queries
tickets.description: Implement POST /api/raw/query and POST /api/shared/query endpoints that return unallocated source records and allocated shared-cost records respectively, paginated and filterable by date and platform.
acceptance: POST /api/raw/query returns 200 with unallocated records for a sample month
POST /api/shared/query returns shared-cost records and preserves totals
API endpoints include pagination and input validation tests

tickets.title: REST API: platforms and portfolios
tickets.description: Implement GET /api/platforms and GET /api/platforms/{platformId} and equivalent portfolio endpoints to list available allocation targets and metadata used by Power BI and consumers.
acceptance: GET /api/platforms returns a list of platforms with IDs and names
GET /api/platforms/{platformId} returns platform metadata including portfolio mapping
Endpoints return appropriate 404 for unknown ids

tickets.title: REST API: month-to-date and previous-month file exports
tickets.description: Implement GET /api/files/month-to-date and GET /api/files/previous-month to retrieve file listings and pre-signed download URLs for chargeback exports produced from Gold rollups.
acceptance: Endpoints return lists of files with timestamps and sizes
Pre-signed URLs are returned and validate with a successful HTTP GET
File export entries match names and timestamps in S3

tickets.title: Power BI semantic model and chargeback reports
tickets.description: Build a Power BI semantic model and reports that consume the REST API and Gold datasets to produce chargeback reports and dashboards for business units and portfolios.
acceptance: Power BI dataset refresh succeeds against the REST API for a sample month
Chargeback report shows rollups per business unit and reconciles to Gold totals
Semantic model includes platform/portfolio dimensions and chargeback cost center fields

tickets.title: Orchestration and scheduling
tickets.description: Define orchestration to schedule Lambda extraction, Databricks Medallion jobs and allocation runs, including retry and backfill behaviors and alerting on failures.
acceptance: Orchestration runbook specifies schedule, retries and backfill steps
Example schedule triggers a pipeline end-to-end run in test environment
Orchestration supports manual backfill with documented commands

tickets.title: Monitoring, logging and alerting
tickets.description: Implement monitoring for ingestion and allocation jobs, centralised logging and alerts for failures (schema validation, reconciliation mismatches, API errors) with actionable runbooks.
acceptance: Alerts fire for schema validation errors and reconciliation mismatches in test runs
Centralised logs allow tracing a run id across Lambda and Databricks
Runbooks exist for the top three alert types

tickets.title: CI/CD, automated tests and code review workflow
tickets.description: Establish CI/CD pipelines, unit and integration tests for the Lambda, validator, and Databricks jobs, and a code review workflow that enforces tests passing before merge.
acceptance: CI pipelines run validator and unit tests on PRs and block merges on failures
Integration smoke tests run nightly and report status
A CONTRIBUTING or docs/ page describes the code review workflow

tickets.title: Access control and data governance
tickets.description: Define access control for Databricks, S3 and the REST API, and a data governance policy for PII and cost data retention in Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
acceptance: Access control matrix lists roles and permissions for Databricks/S3/API
Data retention policy documented for each Medallion layer
PII rules annotated on fields and ETL steps that scrub or mask sensitive values

tickets.title: Parallel run and reconciliation against Apptio TBM Studio
tickets.description: Run the new allocation pipeline in parallel with Apptio TBM Studio and reconcile results to prove parity or explain deltas, producing a cutover readiness report.
acceptance: Parallel run produces a reconciliation report comparing totals and top 20 deltas
Differences are explained with root causes for >1% deltas
Cutover readiness checklist completed and signed off

tickets.title: Documentation and runbooks
tickets.description: Produce operational runbooks and user documentation for running the pipeline, adding new mappings, and triaging exceptions reports and reconciliation failures.
acceptance: Runbooks cover extraction, medallion jobs, allocation and reconciliation
Onboarding doc shows steps to add a new portfolio mapping
Docs reviewed and linked from README.md

tickets.title: User acceptance testing and Apptio cutover
tickets.description: Plan and execute user acceptance tests and the cutover from Apptio, including stakeholder signoffs, final reconciliation and rollback plan.
acceptance: UAT scripts executed with stakeholder signoffs recorded
Final reconciliation shows acceptable variance or documented adjustments
Cutover plan and rollback steps documented
